details: CONFIRMED by reading add() (writes license_path only) and settings() (reads [license] that add never writes). The owner's
UPDATE in the brief: "One command does everything: relay license add <id> --holder <name> writes LICENSE (root, for GitHub),
LICENSES/<id>.txt ..., REUSE.toml ..., and [license] id, holder in .claude/kit.toml". docs/setup.md and the bin/relay usage
describe the pre-update design and need the same update; the one-time reuse lint verification is also not recorded in the
worker report. Size: 45 agent minutes.
evidence: probe: `relay license add MIT --holder me --headers -C probe/p` -> "wrote LICENSE (MIT)"; `ls` -> a.py LICENSE third_party vendor
(no LICENSES, no REUSE.toml, no .claude/kit.toml written).
failing_case: In an empty git repo: `relay license add MIT --holder amidman`.
Now: only LICENSE is written; ls shows no LICENSES/, no REUSE.toml, and .claude/kit.toml gets no [license] (so `relay license
check` then does nothing at all: settings() returns None).
Should: LICENSE, LICENSES/MIT.txt (same SPDX text), REUSE.toml with one [[annotations]] path = "**", precedence = "closest",
SPDX-FileCopyrightText = "2026 amidman", SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT", and [license] id = "MIT", holder = "amidman" in
.claude/kit.toml; `uvx --quiet --from 'reuse[charset-normalizer]==6.2.0' reuse lint` in that repo says compliant.
fix_hint: In add(): after LICENSE, write LICENSES/<id>.txt with the same text, write REUSE.toml (version = 1 plus one annotation) when
missing (refuse when present and it does not cover "**" with the id), and append [license] to kit.toml through one helper
shared with relay_setup.set_license (move license_block into relay_license). Update docs/setup.md and the usage text.
pass_cases: 1. empty repo, `relay license add MIT --holder amidman --year 2026` -> files LICENSE, LICENSES/MIT.txt, REUSE.toml exist;
LICENSE == LICENSES/MIT.txt byte for byte; tomllib(REUSE.toml)["annotations"] == [{"path": "**", "precedence": "closest",
"SPDX-FileCopyrightText": "2026 amidman", "SPDX-License-Identifier": "MIT"}]; tomllib(.claude/kit.toml)["license"] ==
{"id": "MIT", "holder": "amidman"}; then `relay license check` exits 0.
2. Apache-2.0 --holder amidman -> LICENSE and LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt equal the bundled text unchanged; REUSE.toml copyright
"<year> amidman".
3. run the same add twice -> second run exit 0, no file content changes (REUSE.toml, kit.toml unchanged).
4. LICENSE exists and differs -> refused, exit 1, and none of LICENSES/, REUSE.toml, kit.toml is written (kept as today).
5. existing kit.toml with other tables -> [license] appended, other tables byte-unchanged.
